      "name": "aircraft_cabin_freshness",

      "name": "post_covid_service_change",
      "analytical_usefulness": 0.55,
      "source_groundedness": 0.9,
      "hallucination_observed": false,
      "rationale": "Niche but potentially useful axis; 'no_comparison_made' dominates and is correctly applied to rows that make no temporal comparison, keeping it well grounded."

  "analytical_usefulness": 0.75,
  "source_groundedness": 0.68,
  "rationale": "The added columns provide multiple genuine thematic axes (crew, seats, meals, value, ground staff, cabin, post-covid) that give real leverage for grouping Overall Rating by Type of Traveller and Class, so table-level usefulness is solid despite mild overlap with existing rating columns. The main weakness is groundedness: the evidence samples reveal a strongly correlated 'all-positive' or 'all-negative' pattern where columns assert specifics (ground staff, cost-cutting, value, cabin, meals) for rows whose text is silent on those topics, and sample 4 even contradicts the text ('older aircraft' -> 'new_modern'). Where NULL/neutral defaults are used, behaviour is correct and not penalised."
